purpose: Teach: 悩まさ/東側/闘病/口論/丹/いとう/づらく/粗

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界、規制に悩まされている、各社、苦戦中だ。
lines.en: The industry is being hammered by regulation. Every company is struggling with it.
lines.style: Direct, measured opening. Factual weight without dramatics. Steady eye contact. Brief pause before the second sentence—letting the problem land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場、東側のシェアが、伸びてきました。
lines.en: Yes. Market share in the eastern region has started picking up.
lines.style: Respectful, precise. Slightly formal register—a subordinate reporting upward. Even pacing. Careful not to overstate the progress.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 前社長、長期闘病の末、引退された経緯がある。
lines.en: The previous president went through a long illness before his retirement.
lines.style: Quiet, deliberate. Respectful pause after the opening. Not gossiping—acknowledging context that matters. Steady voice, no edge.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内、来期方針で、口論、起きないよう、調整します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we manage the internal discussions about next term's direction so nothing escalates.
lines.style: Attentive, reassuring. Leaning slightly into the commitment. Not rushed. Shows he understands the weight of what's being asked.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 丹念な現場視察、新人にも、経験させろ。
lines.en: I want the new staff to see the operations firsthand too. Make it part of their training.
lines.style: Clear directive, but not harsh. Slight emphasis on the word 'new'—he wants them to learn this way. Expectation, not punishment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、社業に労をいとうことなく、努めてくれています。
lines.en: Yes. Our staff have been putting in the effort without complaint. They're working hard on the business.
lines.style: Warm undertone beneath the formal report. Genuine appreciation for his team showing through. Measured pace. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: クレーム、扱いづらく感じる客には、私が、直接応対する。
lines.en: For complaints—the more difficult customers—I'll handle those myself.
lines.style: Firm but not cold. Definitive pause after the dash. Taking responsibility on his shoulders. Not delegating the hard part.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。初期の試作品、粗削りでしたが、改善、進んでおります。
lines.en: Yes. The early prototypes were rough around the edges, but we're making real progress now.
lines.style: Honest assessment without defensiveness. Acknowledges past roughness, then shifts forward with quiet confidence. Even, steady pacing.
